mapper.select: SELECT r.ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_CODE, r.ROLE_CHNAME, r.RECORD_STATUS, r.SYS_CODE, r.CREATE_TIME, r.CREATE_USER, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_USER, r.REMARK FROM PT_ROLE r INNER JOIN PT_USER_ROLE ur ON r.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 0
SELECT ur.ROLE_ID FROM PT_USER_ROLE ur INNER JOIN PT_ROLE r ON ur.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PT_USER u INNER JOIN PT_USER_ROLE ur ON u.USER_ID = ur.USER_ID WHERE ur.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
AND (u.USERNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.USERCHNNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
